gui.agentPrompt.label: MCP connection prompt
gui.agentGuide.intro: Generate a connection prompt and send it to your Agent. The Agent will configure AiNiee-Next MCP and check the connection.
gui.agentGuide.chooseClientBody: Choose from the clients below. Check that your version's Agent mode supports MCP and can run local tools.
gui.agentGuide.sendPromptBody: Use the button below to generate and copy the prompt. Paste it into an Agent conversation in your chosen client and ask the Agent to follow it to set up and verify the connection automatically.
gui.agentGuide.nextBody: Once the Agent confirms that the AiNiee-Next tools are available, tell it which input file to use, what operation to perform, and the target language.
gui.agentGuide.environment: Use a computer or environment that can access the AiNiee-Next project directory. The client must allow the Agent to run local commands and configure MCP.
